note: Java bridge: new programmatic in-process client. VesperaClient.create() (or .forApp("admin")) builds requests with a fluent VesperaRequest (method, path, percent-encoded query params, headers, raw json/text/form/bytes bodies, InputStream bodies over bidirectional streaming, remote_addr/scheme) and returns a VesperaResponse (status, headers, body bytes/string, hoisted 422 validation errors) without HTTP or the proxy controller. send() dispatches SYNC (parks on virtual threads), sendAsync() uses dispatchAsync. HTTP error statuses are responses; transport failures throw the unchecked VesperaClientException. Domain JSON is never parsed. The Spring autoconfiguration registers a VesperaClient bean (@ConditionalOnMissingBean), independent of controller-enabled.
